scale.how: there is NO printed dimension on this sheet, so use a length you already know: the acoustic ceiling grid is a 2 ft x 2 ft grid. Ten grid cells in the clear band above the building measure 432.5 px, so 432.5 / 20 ft = 21.63 px per ft. Cross-check: the floor plan of the same module (va_floor) has a printed 10'-0" dimension that gives 21.6 px per ft, 0.1 % apart. The 0-16 ft graphic bar in the corner gives 43.3 px per ft - exactly 2x too much - and must not be used.

scale_refs.label: ten ceiling grid cells (2 ft each) = 20 ft
scale_refs.note: Count the cells before you box them: the box must run from one grid line to the grid line ten cells away.

scale_refs.label: 0-16 ft graphic scale bar
scale_refs.note: Do NOT set the scale from this bar. It measures 692 px from its 0' mark to its 16' mark, which is 43.3 px per foot - exactly twice the 21.6 px per foot that the printed dimensions on the sheet give. The bar is the one drawn for a 1/4" = 1'-0" sheet, left on a sheet that is plotted at 1/8" = 1'-0" (the sheet prints SCALE: 1/8" = 1'-0" right next to it, and the legend page shipped with these drawings, va_legend.png, carries the same bar over SCALE: 1/4" = 1'-0" - that is the sheet the bar belongs to). Anything measured with the bar comes out 2x too long and, because area is a length times a length, 4x too big.

2x4 light fixture.tip: Pick a horizontal fixture as your example; a rotated one loses about 40 % of the count and starts returning the stipple-hatched toilet ceilings. The size filter 0.7-1.4 is what keeps the 2x2 fixtures out of this count - the model sees them as the same family, only smaller.

measured.note: measured on the shipped image with a student-like (jittered) example box

2x2 light fixture.tip: Same size filter, the other way round: without it, one 2x2 example returns all 49 fixtures on the sheet.

measured.note: measured on the shipped image with a student-like (jittered) example box

recessed light.tip: The cleanest count on the whole sheet. The stipple hatching in the toilet rooms does not bother it, so any of the fourteen works as the example.

measured.note: measured on the shipped image with a student-like (jittered) example box

tasks: There is no printed dimension on this sheet. Box ten cells of the 2 ft x 2 ft ceiling grid (label: scale: ten ceiling grid cells (2 ft each) = 20 ft) - that is 20 ft.
Box the 0-16 ft graphic bar at the top right as well (label: scale: 0-16 ft graphic scale bar) and compare. One of the two is wrong by a factor of 2.
Box ONE 2x4 light fixture - a horizontal one, in a clear part of the ceiling - with the label 'example: 2x4 light fixture' and SAM 3 counts them all.
Do the same for the 2x2 light fixtures (label: example: 2x2 light fixture) and for the small round recessed lights (label: example: recessed light).
There are no air diffusers, no return registers and no sprinkler heads anywhere on this sheet. Check the legend before you go looking for them.
